text:
nora: quick notes from today's small speculative-warmup run on ember-13b-quant candidate. dropping results + a short eval plan.

ishaan: cool — what exactly is 'speculative-warmup' here?

nora: run ember-mini-3b-quant to predict first M tokens, stream them as provisional while main 13B computes. confirm/regen if mismatch. aim: reduce client-first-byte for short replies.

zhen: any numbers?

bench-bot: local dev snapshot:
```
cheap p50/token 10ms
main p50/token 24ms
M=6 -> client-first-byte p50 ~58ms vs baseline ~150ms
short-prompt end2end p95 -30%
```

nora: quality: 350-sample holdout => EM-like drop 0.9%, embed cosine delta -0.01, human AB (50): warmup preferred 20%, baseline 62%, tie 18%. structured extraction suffers most.

ishaan: mitigation ideas?

nora: confidence gate (top1>0.65 & margin>0.25) and token-type filter helped; tradeoffs: quality up, latency gains down. added small length-bias correction when merging.

zhen: cost? running both increases infra but many short sessions finish in warm window. estimate: per-short-session cost ~-10%, long sessions neutral/worse. route-level enable only.

nora: proposed eval plan: 5k stratified holdout (QA, extract, summarize, code, chat), 4 configs (aggr/default/cons/token-filter), metrics: EM/ROUGE/embed-sim/regen-rate/latency p50/p95/cost, N=600 human per cfg on priority tasks, adversarial token-split suite.

ishaan: ops reqs: telemetry prefs (attempted/streamed/confirmed/regens), tracing spans warmup/start & warmup/confirm, auto-disable rule if regen_rate>10% or pref-delta>5% over 24h.

nora: runtime impl: api flag warmup:{model,m,conf}, ephemeral KV for logits, provisional stream flag for clients. I'll push configs and upload harness logs.

zhen: SGTM. can you also add a small synthetic set with company names and hyphenation to stress tokenization?

nora: yes — will add 800 adversarial cases. ping when expanded runs done, then quick sync. :rocket:
